title: tour with very good guide
text: We booked this tour very late because it was the only way we could get into the Alhambra, but we are glad we did and would recommend booking Alhambra tours with Play Granada. Our guide, Jesus, was very friendly and helpful, and his insightful commentary taught us a lot not only about the history of the Alhambra itself but of Spain in general. We enjoyed a chat with Jesus while walking from the Generalife, the final point of the tour, back toward the Alhambra gardens, and wish him all the best!
author: Richard_W

title: Price expensive. Sandra excellent
text: The price of the ticket was exorbitant. But Sandra was an excellent guide. Informative and professional. Very good.
author: 205erumn

title: Last minute tour option for Alhambra
text: Very interesting and very knowledgeable guide. There is a lot of uphill walking and some pretty steep inclines. There were rest breaks but not for people who aren't in very good shape. There were 6 in our group which gave the guide a little more flexibility for stops along the way. We booked last minute and this was our only option so there was a premium for the tickets.
author: Foody4seeker

title: Jesus excellent guide
text:
Jesus is an excellent guide, with a lot of very interesting information and very pleasant. 
I highly recommend that you do your tour with him, you are going to learn a lot.
author: domenicam629

title: Excellent Tour
text: Samuel explain a lot of Spain’s history and gave us details that helped us understand the history of the Alhambra. He’s very knowledgeable and was attentive to everyone’s needs. I fully recommend Samuel as an excellent tour guide for the Alhambra.
author: Edna_V

title: Wonderful Tour
text: Highly recommend tour of The Alhambra and surrounding areas. My friends & I did not want it to end. Sandra was a wonderful guide. Her humor made the day. I would suggest going back an additional day to check out the area. So much history, Sandra was a gem! We booked last minute & paid a premium. Totally worth it! Suggest booking 3-4 weeks in advance.
author: Sally_H

title: Best guide
text: Amazing guide, Jesus gave us the best tour, he was knowledgeable, well prepared and had extremely interesting stories to share. He was accommodating to my family who is older and walks slowly. I also appreciated that he spoke clearly and slowly, my mom (81) could understand. I learned so many new things about the Alhambra and about  the history of Granada. I love this city so much. It’s my second time visiting and my first time entering the Alhambra. I 100% recommend Jesus for this tour.
author: pilare924

title: Informative visit to the Alhambra
text: Our guide, Sandra, was very knowledgeable and didn’t overwhelm us with too much information. We were with her for about 3 and a half hours but, with how much there was to see, it flew by quickly. This tour is best for people with a decent level of fitness as there is a lot of walking involved.
author: ReniePenie

title: Sandra is an amazing...
text: Sandra is an amazing guide, incredibly knowledgeable, and the Alhambra is breathtakingly beautiful. The cost of the ticket in this experience is incredibly expensive, but that is what you get when you book last minute instead of in advance on the Alhambra website. I hope some of the exorbitant costs go to the guides like Sandra themselves.
author: Sarah_D

title: Sandra was great!
text: Sandra was a great tour guide. Interesting comments, kind person and very organized!
author: careys901
